_comment: DogPull settings. `destination: null` means <RM drive>/DogPull/<folderName>. Set it to an absolute path to pull onto an external drive instead.
_channelConfirmed: @XanderBudnick confirmed by Garrett as the correct channel.
_qualityNote: Ceiling is 'best available up to 4K', not a fixed size. Shorts are cropped 9:16 out of 16:9 source: from 1080p that leaves ~608px wide and has to be upscaled ~1.8x to fill a 1080x1920 short, which looks soft. From 4K the same crop is ~1215px wide and gets downscaled, which stays sharp and leaves room to reframe. Videos only ever uploaded at 1080p simply come down at 1080p — asking for more costs nothing there. Run --dry-run to see what this channel actually offers and what it will cost. Use --height 1440 to halve the size, or --height 1080 for the smallest.
